saved asset protects original while canvas has no media reference

delete-first native transactions reject new dangling reference and retain prior document
malformed or unknown document versions preserve exact previous record
deleted whole project does not permanently pin detached canvas history

actual UI displays injected quota failure and keeps old committed project document
save error and retry remain visible below navigation at 390px emulation
